text:
I was experimenting with something else, so there wasn't really a proper prompt for this one. But I liked the result a lot, so decided to share it.

Generated it with Seedance 2.0 in 480p, then upscaled it to 4K using Topaz Starlight Precise 2.5 through @mitte_ai https://t.co/IwUJ5gzdVj
content: Generate with Seedance 2.0 at 480p, then upscale to 4K using Topaz Starlight Precise 2.5 via mitte_ai

translations.es: Genera con Seedance 2.0 a 480p, luego mejora a 4K usando Topaz Starlight Precise 2.5 a través de mitte_ai
translations.fr: Générez avec Seedance 2.0 en 480p, puis upscalez en 4K en utilisant Topaz Starlight Precise 2.5 via mitte_ai.

---
Seedance 2.0で480pで生成し、次にTopaz Starlight Precise 2.5を使用してmitte_ai経由で4Kにアップスケールします。
translations.ko: Seedance 2.0을 사용하여 480p로 생성한 후, mitte_ai를 통해 Topaz Starlight Precise 2.5를 사용하여 4K로 업스케일하십시오.
translations.pt-BR: Gere com Seedance 2.0 em 480p, depois faça o upscale para 4K usando Topaz Starlight Precise 2.5 via mitte_ai
